fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Buses/BusPdp.cy.js#Buses - BusPdp [starbusUltraCityElectric] [en] — Tata Starbus Ultra City Electric TC-BUSPDP-02: Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Tata Starbus Ultra City Electric
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BUSPDP-02
**Title:** Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Tata Starbus Ultra City Electric
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open Tata Starbus Ultra City Electric, click Check Offers, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real required-field validation messages for name, mobile and location are shown, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open Tata Starbus Ultra City Electric
2. Click Check Offers
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify the three required-field messages
